brief:
A child in Gaza died from lead poisoning traced to battery repair operations in displacement camps, Shehab Wire reported. The workshops, which lack proper ventilation, have exposed thousands of children to chronic lead poisoning in conditions where medical screening remains inadequate.

The proliferation of informal battery repair shops in crowded tent settlements has created a public health crisis among the displaced population. Workers and nearby residents, particularly children, face severe contamination risks from lead and other toxic materials handled without safety protocols or protective equipment.

title: Battery repair workshops poison Gaza children with lead
